title: Partner Program Guide | Bright Data
snippet:
Bright Data is the world's leading web data infrastructure platform, trusted by 20,000+ organizations globally -
from Fortune 500 companies to the fastest-growing AI startups.
We give businesses the ability to collect, access, and use public web data at scale - powering competitive
intelligence, AI training data, market research, pricing intelligence, eCommerce analytics, and more.
As a Bright Data partner, you gain access to one of the most trusted brands in web data infrastructure - and the
commercial opportunity that comes with it. Our partner program is designed for ﬁrms who want to build
something real. We are selective about who we partner with, and we invest seriously in the relationships we
choose.
This guide covers everything you need to know about how the program works, what we expect from each other,
and how to get the most out of the relationship.
About This Guide
This guide provides all Bright Data partners with an overview of the program structure, beneﬁts, requirements, and
operating procedures. It is intended for use by partner leadership, sales, technical, and compliance teams.

and at brightdata.com/pricing, as updated from time to time. The current portfolio includes:
Web Unlocker, Browser API, SERP API, Scraper APIs, Datasets, Web Archive, Retail Intelligence,
and Managed Data Acquisition.

title: Authentication
snippet:
Bright Data ensures secure access to its services. Bright Data provides two primary methods for authentication:
1. **API Access** - Authenticate and interact with the Bright Data platform using an API key/token.
2. **Native Access** - Authenticate and interact with the Bright Data platform using proxy protocol `username` and `password`.
Both API and Native access methods are billed at the same rate. Usage is charged according to your pricing plan for each Bright Data product.
## How do I authenticate with API Key?
An API key is a secure hashed token used to authenticate with Bright Data API. We create a default key for you upon account creation automatically. You can create additional API keys for different users and with different permissions.
Manage your API Keys anytime in the [Account settings](https://brightdata.com/cp/setting/users).
### How do I relay the API key within a request?
Here’s an example request:
Sample Request
```
curl --request POST \
--url https://api.brightdata.com/request \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
"zone": "my_unlocker_zone",
"url": "https://example.com/page",
"format": "json",
"method": "GET",
"country": "us",
"data_format": "markdown"
}'
```

This `<token>` is your **API key**, which is required for every API request.

title: Get pricing plans
snippet:
The `GET /pricing_plans` endpoint returns your account’s current pricing plan and the other plans available to your account, with the per-product prices of each plan. All prices are in USD.
Paste your API key into the authorization field. To get an API key, [create an account](https://brightdata.com/?hs_signup=1&utm_source=docs&utm_campaign=playground) and learn [how to generate an API key](/api-reference/authentication#how-do-i-generate-a-new-api-key%3F).
## Which API key permission does this endpoint need?
`GET /pricing_plans` requires the `billing.read` permission. API keys with the **Admin** or **Finance** [permission level](/api-reference/authentication#what-permissions-level-does-an-api-key-have) have it. Keys with the Ops, Limit or User permission level cannot call this endpoint.
## How do I get my current pricing plan?
Call `GET /pricing_plans` with an Admin or Finance API key. The endpoint takes no parameters:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
"https://api.brightdata.com/pricing_plans"
```
The response contains a `plans` array. Your current plan is the entry where `is_current` is `true`. To print only that plan, filter the response with [jq](https://jqlang.org/):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
"https://api.brightdata.com/pricing_plans" \
| jq '.plans[] | select(.is_current)'
```

#### Authorizations
Use your Bright Data API Key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
How to authenticate:
1. Obtain your API Key from the Bright Data account settings at [https://brightdata.com/cp/setting/users](https://brightdata.com/cp/setting/users)
2. Include the API Key in the Authorization header of your requests
3. Format: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`
Example:
```
Authorization: Bearer b5648e1096c6442f60a6c4bbbe73f8d2234d3d8324554bd6a7ec8f3f251f07df
```
Learn how to get your Bright Data API key: [https://docs.brightdata.com/api-reference/authentication](https://docs.brightdata.com/api-reference/authentication)

title: FAQ - Bright Data
snippet:
The Bright Data Partner Program is a structured channel program that enables qualified firms to resell, refer, or build solutions with Bright Data's web data infrastructure products. It is designed to help partners expand their offerings, generate new revenue streams, and bring Bright Data to customers in new markets and territories.
### What types of partnerships does Bright Data offer?
Bright Data currently offers four partnership models:
- Referral Partner — introduces potential customers to Bright Data and earns a commission on converted revenue
- Certified Reseller — purchases Bright Data products at a discount and resells directly to customers
- Premier Reseller — manages the full customer lifecycle including onboarding, support, and growth, at a higher discount level
- Strategic Alliance — global technology platforms such as AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks that co-sell and/or list Bright Data on their marketplace
### What products can partners sell or refer?
Partners can sell or refer the full Bright Data product portfolio including Web Unlocker, Browser API, SERP API, Scraper APIs, Datasets, Web Archive, Retail Intelligence, Managed Data Acquisition, and AI/web access products. The full and current product list is available at brightdata.com/pricing.

You will receive:
- a partner agreement for review and signature
- an introduction to your Partner Manager
- access to the partner onboarding process including training and enablement materials
- instructions for completing KYC and AUP compliance requirements before your account is activated

title: Bright Data - Affiliate API reference
snippet:
We need the following information from sales/partner:
1. Partner name: letters only
2. Which DNS url they would like to use. This DNS name should be aliased to: brd.superproxy.io.
3. Authorized IPs to add to our allowlist. Other IPs will be blocked from invoking our afiiliate APIs.
4. List of products they to resell out of this list:
| Proxy type | Product type | Required information |
|---|---|---|
| Datacenter | Rotating pool | Pool size, Countries, Amount of proxies per country |
| | Unlimited shared | List of countries, Amount of IPs per country |
| | Unlimited dedicated | List of countries, Amount of IPs per country |
| ISP | Rotating pool | Pool size, Countries, Amount of proxies per country |
| | Unlimited shared | List of countries, Amount of IPs per country |
| | Unlimited dedicated | List of countries, Amount of IPs per country |
##
​
High level affiliate flow
To offer Bright Data proxy services, affiliate should follow this flow.
1. Setup affiliate account with Bright Data
2. For each end user: open user in Bright Data
3. For each product sell: setup zone in Bright data (limit: 50 zones per user)
4. Each zone will have its own access information set: proxy username and password.

```
curl -X POST "https://api.brightdata.com/example/signup_shared_isp"
```
